# OptionsDash

> OptionsDash is an options trading dashboard optimized for SPX iron condors —
> real-time P&L, chaos-scored news, wheel tracking, and an AI-ready API.

## What it is

- Analysis and monitoring dashboard for options traders. It does **not** execute
  orders — orders stay with your broker.
- Specialty: **SPX / SPXW iron condors** with an interactive P&L visualizer,
  live Greeks, breakevens, and probability of profit.
- Also supports: short straddles, calendar spreads (Black-Scholes pricing),
  and wheel tracking (cash-secured puts, covered calls) on indexes and
  single stocks.
- Market data: Schwab (real-time SPX/SPXW pricing) and WeBull (live holdings sync).
- Chaos-scored news: headlines ranked by expected market impact, with sentiment badges.
- Agent API: full dashboard access over HTTP; a single request returns
  SPX/VIX, positions, strategies, news, and macro events, with an
  LLM-friendly `?format=text` option.

## Pricing

- Free plan (top of funnel)
- Dashboard — $20/month: manual trading desk (builders, wheel tracker,
  signals/checklist, chaos news, saved strategies/scenarios)
- Dashboard + Agent — $29/month: everything in Dashboard plus MCP server /
  API access and agent-oriented workflows

## FAQ

- **Is it only for SPX?** No — optimized for SPX iron condors, but it tracks
  single-stock positions (e.g. wheel trades) synced from WeBull.
- **Is this for trading or analysis?** Analysis and monitoring only.
- **Which brokerages are supported?** Schwab and WeBull.
- **Can AI agents use this?** Yes — the agent API exposes the full dashboard
  via simple HTTP calls.
- **What is Section 1256?** IRS tax treatment for broad-based index options
  like SPX: 60% of gains taxed at the long-term rate, 40% at short-term,
  regardless of holding period.
